original.target_description: Relationship between typological proximity to previously acquired linguistic systems (L1 and L2) and third-language (L3) transfer, assessed through knowledge of adjectival semantic nuances associated with noun-raising; English lacks this property and the other languages share it.

replication.target_description: Replication full paper located and title verified. The neutral typological-transfer description and PDF p. 9 do not uniquely select a task/test. The results report group main effects and group-by-position interactions, with multiple candidates at the cited page. No statistic was assigned based on input order.

reported_success.location: p. 1450 (PDF p. 12), Discussion and Conclusion, paragraph 1; Table 2
reported_success.quote: Overall, the results of the two ANOVAs point to a partial replication of the original analysis.

notes:
Reported success is the authors’ overall partial-replication verdict, mapped to mixed; it is not an effect-specific significance inference. Original statistics quoted secondhand by the replication were not substituted for the unavailable original primary paper. Supplied original page 12 cannot disambiguate without the original primary paper. PDF p. 9 reports both collocation group and interaction tests.
